summary: Retry exact PR head after governed push

delivery.outcome: A successfully pushed governed branch can reuse its one open PR across GitHub's bounded stale-head read window without weakening exact-head delivery
nonGoals: No retry for absent, duplicate, malformed or failed pull-request queries
No weakening of the final exact-head comparison
No release carrier, package publication, Git tag or GitHub Release change

architecture.decision: Repeat only an otherwise valid one-PR query whose head SHA is stale, using a small fixed retry budget and preserving the terminal fail-closed error
architecture.rollback: Remove the bounded stale-head retry and restore the immediate exact-head failure

validation.evidence: one stale head followed by the current head reuses the existing PR after one bounded wait
a persistently stale head exhausts the budget and raises the exact-head diagnostic
absence, ambiguity and invalid query results retain fail-closed semantics without stale-head retry expansion
focused/full tests, lint, governance and package/container builds pass
